speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are pregnant and experiencing vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain; please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms started. To assess the urgency, have you passed any tissue or clots, and is the pain constant or cramping?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (likely with vasa previa given the cessation of contractions after bleeding onset and prior C-section history). REQUEST IMAGES: Transabdominal Ultrasound and Transvaginal Ultrasound to evaluate placental location, myometrial invasion, and fetal membranes.
